summary: Deep-audit-reconciled conformance matrix for native PM-owned fff-inspired DiscoveryService consumers. This matrix is source-lineage only and does not create WorkNodes, tools, queues, or canonical Plans.
common_conformance_requirements: Consumer calls the shared DiscoveryService substrate or an approved route that delegates to it.
Request includes consumer_id, surface_type, project/worktree or remote/SSH identity, query_text, intent, target_kind, limit/budget, current_context when available, and policy_context.

Request, result, freshness, fallback_state, policy_decision, error_code, and receipt_event enum fields use the exact registry in state/precision_contract.json; fallback_denied_stale_cases use either exact enum values or exact_value_registry.conformance_case_label.
Results carry rank, score/provenance, freshness_state, fallback_state, policy_decision, source_index_generation, and requires_exact_verification.
Consumers honor the performance/resource budgets and over_budget/fallback behavior in state/precision_contract.json.
Denied and hidden-by-policy states are not converted into success-shaped fallbacks.
GUI consumers preserve shared ranking order unless they disclose a local sort/filter.
Agent consumers perform exact verification before edits or root-cause claims.
Remote/cache/SSH consumers disclose requested/effective remote identity and never silently substitute unrelated local results.
Receipts link discovery, selected candidates, fallback, and exact verification.
candidate_count means visible post-policy count only; blocked/hidden counts are omitted, bucketed, or redacted.
selected_result_ids are opaque/redaction-profiled ids and must not leak raw unauthorized paths.

Assistant Chat discovery visibility settings suppress only routine progress cards, never permission prompts, approval cards, safety messages, trust-affecting fallback/stale disclosures, durable receipts, or exact-verification linkage.
Remote/SSH rows carry permission_snapshot_id, approval_scope_key, host_trust_state/known-host outcome, credential_handle_ref without secret material, and redaction_profile where applicable.
Ambient agent discovery uses trigger/skip rules and is not search-everything-every-turn behavior.

rows.required_call_path: Agent thread invokes discover_paths through DiscoveryService when no exact verified path is available or when module ownership is ambiguous.
request_context_required: intent such as bug_fix or context_acquisition
result_handling: Show discovery activity in the Assistant Chat thread by default.
Respect Settings > Assistant Chat > Activity > `Show file discovery activity in chat` for routine inline activity while preserving safety prompts and durable receipts.
Select candidates for reading, then exact verification.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Must verify with grep/codesearch/Instant Grep, AST/LSP, tests, or domain-specific checks before edit/root-cause claim.
validation_scenarios: setting path and label match the precision contract
permission prompt not suppressed by chat visibility setting
negative_constraints: Do not hide discovery only in backend logs.
Do not leak blocked path names through thread activity.

rows.required_call_path: File mention autocomplete queries DiscoveryService for file/directory/mixed target kinds and preserves service ranking order.
result_handling: Display candidates in DiscoveryService order.
Expose stale/fallback/remote/SSH state compactly when relevant.
Do not show blocked paths as candidates.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Mention selection attaches a source candidate; later agent use still verifies exact content before edits.
receipts_required: discovery.selected when user selects a candidate
validation_scenarios: same query as agent discover_paths returns compatible order
negative_constraints: Do not run a second undisclosed fuzzysort that changes shared ranking.
Do not conflate hidden-by-policy with ordinary no-results when safety disclosure is required.

rows.surface: Quick Open / command palette file search
rows.required_call_path: Quick Open routes path queries through DiscoveryService while keeping existing GUI command names.
result_handling: Preserve service order by default.
If local sort/filter is available, disclose that it is local UI filtering.
Show index/fallback state without leaking hidden paths.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Opening a file does not prove content correctness; agent edits still require exact verification.
negative_constraints: Do not rename established Quick Open UI unnecessarily.
Do not show blocked result counts.

rows.required_call_path: Search panel may use DiscoveryService for path narrowing while regex/content search remains Instant Grep / grep / codesearch.
result_handling: Use discovery only to narrow path/context candidates.
Run content regex through Instant Grep / grep / codesearch for correctness.
Display fallback/stale state inherited from both discovery and content-search paths.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Final content results come from content-search owner, not DiscoveryService ranking.
receipts_required: discovery.invoked when path narrowing is used
negative_constraints: Do not make DiscoveryService the content regex correctness owner.

rows.surface: File Manager type-ahead / editor file navigation
rows.required_call_path: File Manager path type-ahead delegates fuzzy/frecency ranking to DiscoveryService.
result_handling: Display path and directory candidates with policy-safe labels.
Respect shared ranking and local UI filters if disclosed.
Show stale/fallback state for remote/cache/SSH projects.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Navigation is not semantic verification; downstream agent edits verify content separately.
negative_constraints: Do not bypass worktree/remote identity boundaries.

rows.required_call_path: Planning Wizard source/context picking uses DiscoveryService to find relevant project files without creating WorkNodes.
result_handling: Preserve ranked candidates and provenance in Planning Context Capsules when selected.
Expose stale/fallback/denied/no-results states in the picker.
Do not copy unbounded transcripts or unrelated source context.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Selected sources are references for planning; later implementation still verifies exact content before edits.
validation_scenarios: Planning Wizard source pick on local project
Planning Wizard source pick over SSH
negative_constraints: Do not revive Chain Wizard terminology.
Do not create WorkNodes from discovery selection.

rows.surface: PRD Builder source picker / source ingestion
rows.required_call_path: PRD Builder uses DiscoveryService for project source discovery during source ingestion or PRD source selection.
result_handling: Preserve selected candidate provenance in PRD source references.
Expose denied/stale/fallback states without leaking blocked paths.
Route selected sources into PRD pack lineage rather than runtime execution.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: PRD source references remain planning evidence; exact implementation verification occurs later.
validation_scenarios: PRD Builder source pick over SSH
source picker uses same ranking as Assistant Chat for same context
negative_constraints: Do not use raw Assistant Chat transcript as the sole source selection proof.

rows.required_call_path: Orchestrator routes agent file-discovery needs through discover_paths rather than ad hoc repo scans.
result_handling: Use ranked candidates to guide reads.
Record fallback and selected candidates.
Link discovery to exact verification and runtime receipts.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Must verify before assigning edits, claiming root cause, or passing context to Executor.
negative_constraints: Do not silently bypass shared discovery with broad local scans when discovery should apply.

rows.required_call_path: Executor actors use discover_paths when locating files for implementation or verification without exact path evidence.
result_handling: Builder uses candidates for read orientation only.
Verifier can use discovery to locate verification-relevant files but must verify exact evidence.
Receipts feed attempt evidence without becoming the correctness proof.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Required before edits, test claims, completion, or verifier pass.
negative_constraints: Do not let ranking substitute for verifier evidence.

rows.surface: Future WorkNode intake / PlanCompile context materialization
rows.required_call_path: Future WorkNode intake may reference DiscoveryService conformance as a future_boundary_only input contract, but this ledger and compile do not create WorkNodes or NodeSeeds and do not require current runtime conformance proof for the disabled compiler boundary.
result_handling: Record readiness/conformance expectations only.
Do not enqueue executable work.
Do not create NodeSeed candidates before compiler contract exists.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Future compiler must preserve exact verification requirements inherited from source PlanUnits.
receipts_required: future compiler contract only; no runtime receipt in this phase
validation_scenarios: PlanUnit index can describe discovery conformance without creating WorkNodes
negative_constraints: Do not create WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, or final node manifests.
Do not treat this row as current runtime readiness or WorkNode creation permission.

rows.required_call_path: discover_paths is the agent-facing operation that delegates to DiscoveryService.
result_handling: Return ranked candidates with provenance and requires_exact_verification=true unless explicitly exact path verified.
Expose fallback/freshness/policy state.
Use exact result fields from state/precision_contract.json including score_breakdown, source_index_generation, elapsed_ms in receipts, and verification_handoff.
Do not return blocked paths to unauthorized consumers.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Tool output is discovery guidance only; caller must verify content with the appropriate exact mechanism.
validation_scenarios: disabled or unsupported discovery fallback receipt
ambient skip for verified exact path
negative_constraints: Do not make discover_paths a grep replacement.
Do not expose raw frecency history to agents.

rows.required_call_path: Remote/cache/SSH adapter resolves requested/effective project identity and supplies safe file manifests, remote filesystem queries, Git cache inputs, or SSH remote manifest adapter inputs to DiscoveryService.
result_handling: Carry remote/cache/SSH freshness and fallback state into every result.
For SSH MVP, use local DiscoveryService plus SSH remote manifest adapter; no persistent PM remote daemon is required.
Prevent local unrelated fallback.
Keep branch/worktree/SSH identities separate.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Verification must read authorized remote/cache content corresponding to the selected identity, not an unrelated local file.
receipts_required: discovery.fallback when remote/cache/SSH fallback is used
discovery.verified when exact remote verification completes
validation_scenarios: SSH project with no local checkout
SSH manifest adapter with no remote daemon installed
branch switch does not reuse stale wrong-branch index
negative_constraints: Do not collapse remote and local identities.
Do not silently use stale cache as fresh remote truth.

rows.required_call_path: Receipt browsing consumes persisted discovery receipts if promoted; it does not own DiscoveryService behavior.
result_handling: Show discovery receipts, fallback summaries, and verification linkage after the fact.
Respect redaction and no-leak policy.
Remain available even when Assistant Chat inline activity is hidden.
rows.exact_verification_handoff: Browse linkage from discovery receipts to exact verification receipts.
validation_scenarios: Assistant Chat inline display off but receipts remain browseable
SSH discovery receipt shows remote identity
negative_constraints: Do not make receipt browsing the source of product behavior truth.
Do not bypass redaction.
